name: Littoral-Spandrel
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an orbital debris ring in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
